content_of_post_to_answer: No privacy, is it normal or am I overreacting?
answer: Privacy is often misunderstood as secrecy. It is not about hiding things; it is about having control over your own space, thoughts, conversations, and boundaries. The real question is whether the lack of privacy is creating discomfort, fear, or a feeling of being constantly monitored. I've explored this pattern of boundaries and personal space in more detail on my profile if you want to read further. A healthy relationship does not require the absence of privacy; it requires trust strong enough to allow it.
